bill.title: An Act renaming the Institute of Social and Economic Research at the University of Alaska as the Vic Fischer Institute of Social and Economic Research; and naming the Vic Fischer Shoup Bay State Marine Park.

posted_text:
🎓 AK HB79 — Alaska Honors Pioneer: Shoup Bay Marine Park Now Named for Vic Fischer

The state of Alaska has officially renamed Shoup Bay State Marine Park to honor Vic Fischer, a renowned marine biologist and conservationist. This change recognizes his decades of work protecting Alaska's coastal ecosystems.

July 3, 2026: (h) Vetoed by Governor 6/24/26.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.akleg.gov/basis/Bill/Detail/34?Root=HB79
